steps.message:
I fixed the price test. The "tidy up" commit had changed the member discount from 90/100 to 95/100 in `bin/price`, so I changed it back to 90/100.

- `bash scripts/verify.sh` passes.
- I added the change note `changes/CART-58.md`.
- I committed everything as `[CART-58] fix price`.
- I added the `needs-check` label to issue #31 and did not merge or close anything.
